mw.pageTemplates.title: Delivery & payment
mw.pageTemplates.body:
🚚 We deliver every day 7:00 – 20:00.
Delivery fee: $1 in town, free from $20.

💳 Pay by cash on delivery or ABA / KHQR.

Order on our website or call us.

mw.pageTemplates.title: Promotions
mw.pageTemplates.body:
🔥 This week
• Buy 2 get 1 free on all drinks
• 10% off rice 25kg

While stock lasts.

mw.pageTemplates.title: FAQ
mw.pageTemplates.body:
Do you deliver?
Yes, every day 7:00 – 20:00.

Can I pay by QR?
Yes — ABA and KHQR.

Can I return a product?
Yes, within 3 days with the receipt.

mw.pageTemplates.title: Our products
mw.pageTemplates.body:
Fresh bread every morning, cold drinks, snacks, rice, oil and everything for the kitchen.

Ask us if you can't find something — we can order it.

mw.pageTemplates.title: We're hiring
mw.pageTemplates.body:
We are looking for a cashier (full time).
Call us or send a message with your name and phone.
